answer_1.quote: In this study, we evaluate the quality of generated text from two such methods, kNN-LM and TRIME, against the output of baseline LMs that do not use retrieval.

answer_2.quote: We measure quality via the following automatic metrics: MAUVE: MAUVE is an evaluation metric for open-ended text generation... RankGen: Given a prefix and several possible continuations... GPT-3 perplexity: We use GPT-3... Entity-F1: ... Seq-Rep-1: ...

answer_3.quote: We use GPT-3, a large-scale pre-trained language model, to compute the perplexity of text generated with and without interpolation conditioned on the same prefix.

answer_4.quote: We hired three English teachers/editors on the freelance marketplace Upwork. The evaluators' task was to decide which continuation is better, indicate whether it was hard to choose between the two following, and justify their choice... The evaluation focused on whether the generated text is grammatical, fluent, consistent, and logical.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluators' task was to decide which continuation is better, indicate whether it was hard to choose between the two following, and justify their choice in 3 to 4 sentences.
